items.title: Belém (PA) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 9 #004-Cred-Funsau-Sanclin
items.en_title: Belém (PA) Health & medical procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 9 #004-Cred-Funsau-Sanclin
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Belém (PA) is procuring healthcare goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 150,000; proposals close Dec 9 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
